name: shell-guard
description: Holds risky shell and PowerShell commands for the user's decision and blocks edits to secret files; fails closed

mode.title: Risky command mode
mode.description: ask: hold the command and ask. block: refuse it outright. off: guard disabled.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the text this mod shows: en (English) or pt-BR (Português do Brasil)
